title: incident-bot: integrate slo-toolkit heuristics into oncall diagnostics and runbook linking
author: Priya Rao
description:
Motivation: improve incident-bot oncall diagnostics and runbook linking by leveraging heuristics from the slo-toolkit to provide better priority scoring, sampling, and more relevant runbook quick-links. This change wires a small adapter between slo-toolkit and incident-bot, enriches diagnostic payloads with SLI/SLO context, adds weighted priority scoring for suggested runbooks, and surfaces metric-backed hints in oncall messages.

What this PR does: - Adds an adapter that translates slo-toolkit heuristics into incident-bot prioritization signals. - Enriches diagnostic events with SLO context (error budget burn, recent regression flags, owning service). - Adds runbook linker improvements that score and rank runbooks using slo-toolkit weights and context match. - Adds unit and integration tests covering priority scoring and runbook linking. - Updates telemetry: new metrics incident_bot.slo_context_enriched, incident_bot.runbook_score_distribution and a tracing tag slo_toolkit_version. - Small doc note in README/ops about configuration and feature flagging.

Checklist: - [x] Adapter implementation and unit tests - [x] Runbook linker integration and integration tests - [x] CI pipeline updated to run new tests - [x] Telemetry and dashboards proto added - [x] Feature behind runtime feature flag for canary rollout

Linear: ENG-3421 (oncall diagnostics roadmap), ENG-3590 (runbook linking improvements). Related support ticket SUP-7812 for a customer request to prioritize SLO-sensitive runbooks.

Notes on rollout: the feature is behind the runtime flag incident_bot.enable_slo_context and defaulted to off. We will enable for Canary on 2026-03-01 for the core SRE team, monitor the new metrics for score distribution and error budget interactions, then progressively roll out to all oncall rotations.

release_notes: Enhancement: incident-bot can now optionally enrich oncall diagnostics with SLO context and use slo-toolkit heuristics to rank runbooks. Feature behind runtime flag incident_bot.enable_slo_context. Includes telemetry and tests.
testing: Unit tests added for heuristics adapter (tests/unit/test_heuristics_adapter.py) and runbook scoring integration (tests/integration/test_runbook_linking.py). CI updated to run the new suites. Local microbenchmarks included in test artifact diagnostics/bench/enrichment_profile.txt
notes_for_ops: Feature is disabled by default. To enable: set feature flag incident_bot.enable_slo_context to true in runtime config. Monitor metrics incident_bot.runbook_score_distribution and incident_bot.slo_context_enriched and watch for unexpected increases in oncall notification volume. Rolling canary planned for 2026-03-01.
security_implications: No new permissions required; adapter reads readonly SLO metadata via existing slo-toolkit API. Defensive parsing added to avoid malformed payloads impacting bot runtime.
